command.name: axm
command.description:
Open extension manager for AI coding agents.
  Manage skills, MCP servers, subagents, rules, hooks, knowledge, and packs across your AI coding agents from a single CLI.

globalOptions.name: non-interactive
globalOptions.description: Never prompt; fail with guidance when input is required

globalOptions.name: verbose
globalOptions.description: Show full detail: folded rows, plan and finding details, and redacted error diagnostics

globalOptions.name: debug
globalOptions.description: Show redacted cause and stack details; implies --verbose

globalOptions.name: quiet
globalOptions.description: Show only final outcomes, errors, and required actions

globalOptions.name: directory
globalOptions.description: Run as if AXM was started in this directory (relative paths resolve from there)
